create function public.s6_advance(p_room_code text,p_session_token text)returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path=public as $$declare room text:=upper(trim(p_room_code));p public.s1_room_players%rowtype;g public.game_runs%rowtype;s public.s6_run_state%rowtype;begin p:=public.s1_get_player_by_session(room,p_session_token);g:=public.s2_get_active_run(room);select*into s from public.s6_run_state where run_id=g.run_id for update;if s.phase_key='act10_result'then update public.s6_run_state set act_no=11,phase_key='act11_allocation',round_no=1 where run_id=g.run_id;perform public.s6_set_scene(g.run_id,'act11_main_gate','act11_allocation','initial','ACTION_SCREEN','act11.001');elsif s.phase_key='act12_cinematic'and s.escape_success then update public.s6_run_state set phase_key='act13_boundary',act14_boundary_reached=true where run_id=g.run_id;else raise exception'No Sprint
if s.phase_key not in('act9_console','act10_final_vote')then raise exception'No Sprint 6 group choice is open.';end if;
if s.phase_key='act10_final_vote'and p_choice_id not in('take','leave')then raise exception'Invalid ACT 10 choice.';end if;

if s.phase_key='act9_console'and not(case when s.act9_step in(1,3)then p_choice_id in('red','blue','black')when s.act9_step=2 then p_choice_id in('enter_red','do_not_enter')when s.act9_step=4 then p_choice_id in('enter_blue','stay')else false end)then raise exception'Invalid Great Hall choice for current step.';end if;

insert into public.s6_choices values(g.run_id,s.phase_key,s.round_no,p.player_id,p_choice_id,p_client_request_id,null,null,now());select count(*),count(distinct choice_id)into n,d from public.s6_choices where run_id=g.run_id and phase_key=s.phase_key and round_no=s.round_no;if n<3 then return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'submitted',n);end if;

if d=3 then update public.s6_run_state set round_no=round_no+1,updated_at=now()where run_id=g.run_id;perform public.s6_set_scene(g.run_id,'act9_great_hall','act9_console','no_consensus','CRITICAL_INFO','act09.009');return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'no_consensus',true,'action_executed',false,'feedback_text_key','act09.009');end if;
select choice_id into winner from public.s6_choices where run_id=g.run_id and phase_key=s.phase_key and round_no=s.round_no group by choice_id order by count(*)desc,choice_id limit 1;

if s.phase_key='act10_final_vote'then update public.s6_run_state set gold_key=winner='take',alarm_active=winner='take',station_c_bypassed=winner='take',danger_arrives_sooner=winner='take',phase_key='act10_result',updated_at=now()where run_id=g.run_id;if winner='take'then insert into public.s3_group_items(run_id,item_key,label_text_key)values(g.run_id,'golden_key','act10.006')on conflict do nothing;end if;return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'resolved',true,'choice_id',winner);end if;

if s.act9_step=4 and winner='stay'then update public.s6_run_state set round_no=round_no+1,updated_at=now()where run_id=g.run_id;return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'stay',true,'penalty',false,'action_executed',false,'feedback_text_key','act09.021');end if;

if not correct then feedback:=case s.act9_step when 1 then'act09.012'when 2 then'act09.017'when 3 then'act09.019'else'act09.023'end;update public.s6_run_state set act9_step=1,red_activated=false,blue_activated=false,round_no=round_no+1,updated_at=now()where run_id=g.run_id;perform public.s2_log_event(g.run_id,room,null,'escape_penalty_event',p.player_id,jsonb_build_object('penalty_key','great_hall_wrong_door','step',s.act9_step,'choice_id',winner,'feedback_text_key',feedback,'behavior_scoring',false));return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'soft_failure',true,'penalty',true,'feedback_text_key',feedback);end if;

if s.act9_step<4 then update public.s6_run_state set act9_step=act9_step+1,red_activated=true,blue_activated=s.act9_step>=3,round_no=round_no+1,updated_at=now()where run_id=g.run_id;else update public.s6_run_state set act_no=10,phase_key='act10_private',round_no=1,updated_at=now()where run_id=g.run_id;perform public.s6_deliver_clues(g.run_id,10);perform public.s6_set_scene(g.run_id,'act10_golden_key','act10_private','initial','ACTION_SCREEN','act10.004');end if;return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'resolved',true,'choice_id',winner,'penalty',false);end$$;
